name: showandtell
description: Capture supported computer-use action results as local MP4 walkthroughs.

interface.longDescription: Record supported Codex computer-use actions as local MP4 walkthroughs with smooth cursor motion. Keeps the screenshot behind every Mac observation, including text-only accessibility state, saves the screen after each action, and exports in the background. One hook process per call; capture awaits small local writes. Requires Python, FFmpeg, trusted hooks, and local desktop access. The experimental Claude adapter can drive the engine but cannot record yet: that launch runs read-only.
defaultPrompt: Use Showandtell to make a video of this walkthrough.
Use Showandtell to export my saved capture as an MP4.
